method: bedrock:ListInferenceProfiles, then one messages.create per profile through engine.provider.bedrock.make_client (max_tokens 64, one-word prompt). A listed profile is not proof of invoke access: every denied model below is listed in both regions.
note_on_resolution: resolve_model_id('us.anthropic.claude-opus-5') is ambiguous (also matches claude-opus-5-5) and raises ModelResolutionError by design; the unique pattern for Opus 5.5 is 'us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5'. us-west-2 was probed for haiku-4-5, opus-4-5, opus-4-6, opus-4-7, fable-5, opus-5-5 and sonnet-5 with the same outcomes as us-east-1; sonnet-4-5/4-6 were probed in us-east-1 only.
denied_message: Error code: 403 - 'anthropic.<model> is not available for this account.'
